findings.desc: concept-cleanup: legacy case branches for bug_story and file_declarations in describeRequirementSubject and describeRequirementRemediation (repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts lines 436/438/451/453) lack a backward-compat comment; the type union at line 29 has the B-8628 legacy annotation but the switch-case consumers do not, making it non-obvious they are backward-compat stubs for old artifacts rather than active produced paths

quality-cleanup: repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts describeRequirementSubject() and describeRequirementRemediation() have no case for the new primary reason code code_verifiable_behavior_change (lines 434-459). Both switch statements fall through to default, producing generic user-facing messages ("the repro-first classifier requires accepted repro evidence" / "correct the classifier inputs before entering lifecycle work") instead of specific ones for the now-dominant code_verifiable_behavior_change path. The two legacy cases file_declarations and bug_story are still handled explicitly, but the new primary reason introduced by this diff is not.
